nav.footerLine: The cut stays yours — not the model's lottery.

home.kicker: shot control · not a black box
home.lede: Write narration → review the board → swap frames, retry, or upload → compose voice and captions into an MP4. Stills-based talking-head workflow: fast, cheap, controllable. Not happy? Download the asset pack and finish in CapCut.
home.note: demo login · daily free quota · asset pack export
home.flowTitle: Three moves. Then the cut — or take the assets.
home.step1p: Paste narration, rewrite from a reference, or start from a single direction.
home.step2p: Edit copy and prompts. Regenerate art, pull stock, or upload your own still.
home.step3p: FFmpeg composes the cut — or download a ZIP for CapCut polish (transitions, BGM).
home.toolsTitle: SEO pages and workbench stay aligned.

login.lede: Demo session for now. Google sign-in and billing come after launch. Daily free quota still applies.

pricing.lede: Demo login with a daily free quota. Remaining quota shows in the top bar and resets on the UTC date. Paid plans will appear here when billing ships.
pricing.costNote: Daily cap is set by FREE_DAILY_QUOTA (often 30). Exporting an asset pack may spend voiceover points if audio is missing.
pricing.soonLede: Formal pricing will list monthly quotas and overage. Until then, use free quota to validate controllable compose + asset packs.

make.title: One-click compose
